stage.regulatory_basis: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Periodic review of Safety and Security policy
findings.description: No evidence demonstrated of periodic review of the Safety and Security policy by Senior Management and the Safety Review Board.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Safety, Security and Quality policy display and communication
findings.description: The Safety, Security and Quality policy was not displayed at the premises and was not communicated to all workers throughout the organization.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Safety committee
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated that an appropriate safety committee is established and functioning to address safety risks and compliance issues with participation by the Accountable Executive and functional heads.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Emergency Response Plan scenarios
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated that the Emergency Response Plan addresses possible or likely emergency and crisis scenarios relevant to KFL's aviation services and product deliveries.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: ERP continuity of safe operations
findings.description: ERP provisions for continuing the safe production, delivery or support of aviation products and services during emergencies or contingencies were not demonstrated.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: ERP drills and exercises
findings.description: Records were not demonstrated to verify that ERP drills or exercises are conducted in accordance with a plan and that results are documented.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: ERP external coordination
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated that the ERP addresses relevant coordination and integration with external customers and subcontractor organizations, where applicable.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: ERP periodic review
findings.description: Evidence of periodic review of the ERP to confirm continued relevance and effectiveness was not demonstrated.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Safety data analysis
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated of a systematic process for analysing safety data and information to identify trends and produce usable management information.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Hazard identification and Hazard Register
findings.description: A documented process was not demonstrated for identifying hazards from multiple internal and external sources using both reactive and proactive methods. At the time of the Audit there was no evidence of a KFL Hazard Register.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Investigation outputs into risk assessment
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated that hazards and threats identified during incident or accident investigations are transferred into the hazard identification and risk assessment process.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Investigation competence and root cause
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated that safety investigations are conducted by appropriately trained personnel and identify underlying root causes rather than only describing events.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Incident reporting mechanisms
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated of an accessible mandatory incident-reporting system and a simple, confidential voluntary reporting mechanism for errors, hazards and near misses.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Reporting feedback
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated that the reporting process provides appropriate feedback to reporters and, where appropriate, to the regulator after investigations are completed.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Progressive hazard identification
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated that operations, processes, facilities and equipment with aviation safety implications are progressively subjected to hazard identification and risk assessment.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Risk assessment follow-up actions
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated of a process ensuring that follow-up and recommended actions from completed risk assessments are implemented and verified.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Risk assessment approval
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated that completed risk assessment reports receive approval from an appropriate level of management.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: SMS safety performance indicators
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated that the organization's SMS safety performance indicators have been developed and agreed with the regulator.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: SPI definition and monitoring
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated that SPIs linked to safety objectives are defined, promulgated, monitored and analyzed for trends.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: SPI alert levels and targets
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated that appropriate alert levels and/or performance targets have been established for the organization's SPIs.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: SPI corrective action
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated of corrective or follow-up action when SPI targets are not achieved or alert levels are breached.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Management of change
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated that safety-related management-of-change records, including hazard identification and risk-assessment outcomes, are maintained. MOC was not conducted for the Postholder Change (Head of Operations and Chief Pilot), Location Change, New Equipment and Drone change.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Internal audit programme
findings.description: An internal audit programme with a defined schedule and procedures for conducting audits, reporting results, follow-up and maintaining records was not demonstrated.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Structured SMS training programme
findings.description: A structured SMS training programme covering initial and recurrent training, individual duties, roles, responsibilities, accountabilities and operation of the SMS was not demonstrated.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: SMS training effectiveness
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated of a process for measuring SMS training effectiveness and using results to improve subsequent training.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Safety communication channel
findings.description: Evidence was not demonstrated of a safety publication, circular or communication channel through which safety and SMS matters are routinely communicated to employees.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: AVSEC and Safety accountability
findings.description: AVSEC accountability and Safety accountability was not clearly demonstrated. During the time of the Audit the KCAA approval letters were not demonstrated.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Personnel security vetting
findings.description: Personnel security vetting was not demonstrated. Annual recurrent background checks were not demonstrated during the time of the Audit. Personnel vetting records, criminal-record checks, contractor and temporary-worker screening, and access approval records were also not demonstrated.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: UAS secure storage and access control
findings.description: Secure storage and access control for UAS and associated equipment was not demonstrated. The drones were easily accessible by anyone inside the premises and were not under lockable, store-away cabinets. Physical inspection of storage areas, key registers, access logs, inventory records, visitor registers, and security arrangements for batteries, controllers and components.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: UAS protection against tampering
findings.description: Protection of UAS against tampering and unauthorized modification was not demonstrated. Pre-deployment inspection records, tamper-evident controls where appropriate, maintenance records, firmware and configuration controls, and custody records were not demonstrated.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: AVSEC training and awareness
findings.description: AVSEC training and security awareness arrangements were not demonstrated. The training matrix, induction records, refresher training, attendance sheets, competence assessments and contractor awareness records were not demonstrated.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: UAS field operating site security
findings.description: Security controls at UAS field operating sites were not demonstrated. Site risk assessments, site access arrangements, launch/recovery checklists, perimeter controls, visitor management, and security arrangements for temporary or remote sites were not demonstrated.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Security threat reporting and response
findings.description: Procedures for reporting and responding to security threats or unlawful interference were not demonstrated. The AVSEC incident procedure, threat escalation matrix, incident logs, notification records, emergency contact list and records of drills or exercises were not demonstrated.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Unauthorized operations and misuse controls
findings.description: Controls against unauthorized operations and security-sensitive misuse were not demonstrated. Operational approvals, airspace and site authorizations, mission plans, operating restrictions where applicable, and payload and mission authorisation records for the new drones that completed operations in 2026 were not demonstrated. The drones were also not listed in the Operation Specifications.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Unlawful-interference response validation
findings.description: Unlawful-interference and security-event response arrangements were not operationally validated. Response procedures, scenarios for lost control or suspected interference, coordination arrangements with KCAA, air traffic services, site security and law enforcement where appropriate, and security exercises or drills were not demonstrated.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Master fleet record
findings.description: No master fleet record was provided that reconciles each UAS used or tested by KFL to its registration, displayed identification, owner/operator, configuration and serviceability status.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Technical records
findings.description: Technical records were not provided to verify maintenance to manufacturer instructions, rectification before release, or assessment of modifications/software/configuration changes for safety and regulatory impact.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist

findings.title: Flight record set
findings.description: The evidence does not demonstrate a single retrievable record set connecting each flight to aircraft, pilot, authorization, risk assessment, maintenance status, checklist, airspace coordination, payload, occurrence status and outcome.
findings.regulatory_reference: KCARs 2018; KCAA CL: O-SMS003 routine SMS assessment and AVSEC checklist
